'''Massassi village''' was a settlement of the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in the vicinity of the [[Temple of Sacrifice]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Massassi village appears as an area on Yavin in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="TOR" />
